export_evidence: Company website homepage states: "2,000+ Employees • Shipping to 12+ Countries • 11M+ Units Annually • Magnetos • Ignition Coils • Controllers • Sensors" (https://www.indianippon.com/). This is a marketing claim, not a shipment record. No bill-of-lading number, shipment date, destination or HS code could be retrieved: importkey.com/countries/india/india-nippon-electricals-ltd returned only a paywalled shell with zero data rows ("Loading..." / "Shipments available for INDIA NIPPON ELECTRICALS LTD" with no records rendered); volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com returned HTTP 403; importgenius.com returned a JavaScript client challenge. Source counter: 5 aggregator/registry URLs attempted, 0 shipment rows actually seen.
domestic_evidence: Screener.in consolidated P&L (https://www.screener.in/company/INDNIPPON/consolidated/) shows audited-scale domestic revenue: "Sales + 324 336 351 452 525 479 481 566 656 724 845 1,068" for Mar 2015 through Mar 2026, i.e. FY2026 consolidated sales of Rs 1,068 crore, with quarterly sales rising from Rs 158 cr (Mar 2023) to Rs 299 cr (Mar 2026). Company is a listed OEM supplier (BSE: 532240, NSE: INDNIPPON) to 2/3-wheeler makers, so this turnover is overwhelmingly India-market supply. GST-level turnover band and GeM/CPPP tender records were not retrieved (no public access obtained).
note: Legal entity exists and is listed (BSE 532240 / NSE INDNIPPON), incorporated 1984, JV between Lucas Indian Service Ltd (Lucas-TVS) and MAHLE Electric Drives Japan Corporation; plants at Hosur (Tamil Nadu) and Puducherry. Declared HS 870899 (parts/accessories of motor vehicles) is broadly consistent with the actual product line (magnetos, ignition coils, controllers, sensors for 2W/3W), though the company's own description is 'electronic ignition systems' which could also fall under 8511/8543 — HS not corrected here as no customs record was seen to establish the factual code. Export side: only the website's '12+ countries' claim was found; no dated export record, destination or B/L number is public in the sources reachable, so export is classified declared_only, not confirmed. Domestic supply is confirmed by multi-year consolidated turnover. Revenue: FY2026 consolidated sales Rs 1,068 crore (Screener.in). Export volume in value terms: null — not disclosed in the sources read, not invented. No sanctions/court/insolvency findings were checked in this pass (out of scope for this role).
